summary: WiMi Hologram Cloud Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the submission of its annual report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025. The filing discloses financial results: net income increased to RMB 347.1 million (USD 49.4 million) for 2025, up 235.9% from 2024; operating expenses decreased 19.4%; and working capital rose 105.8% to RMB 2,611.6 million. This is a routine periodic filing, not a special-situations event. The press release highlights profitability and cost improvements but does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. No event triggering a special-situation classification is identified.
